question: What BERT models are used?
title: EmotionX-IDEA: Emotion BERT -- an Affectional Model for Conversation
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents explicitly state that FriendsBERT and ChatBERT are adaptations of BERT, specifically designed for multi-utterance emotion recognition tasks. Text 1 and Text 3 confirm that these models are derived from BERT with modifications in pre-training and training procedures.
